note: Under "e2e", the tests each spec file of tests/e2e holds, which npm run check:test-results compares with the run's report. Under "vitest", the floor of tests each Vitest project holds when every one of its files runs, which scripts/vitest-results-reporter.ts checks (U-15). Change a count in the same change that adds, deletes or splits a test; raise a floor when a project grows.
